title: Half and Half Granny Square Crochet Pattern
author: Breann
notes: Starts with a magic ring as published (the "ch 4 and sl st" alternative in the notes was dropped). pattern.dsl left empty: every round states its chains as "(N dc, 8 ch)" and the checker has no plain-chain tally to compare against (it counts chain spaces), so any transcription reports a mismatch. Two-colour square: colour change mid-round with a ch 1 at the colour change; worked in turned rounds.
